name: v10-r5-bugfix
note: V10 R5, added after R1 (PLAN.md amendment, written before R5 runs): R1 reached combined 33 but loses 3 instruction-following dev items round 54 passes (the same 3 C2 loses), so the pre-registered category gate denies it a second seed. Two of them are bug fixes that R1 answers by returning the buggy code unchanged: neither grammar curriculum has a single find-the-bug example. R1's recipe with one change: one verified bug-fix example per C2 program added (idioms.inject_bug on one implementation, kept only if it changes the output on the program's 40 inputs; the answer is the program), +45.6k curriculum tokens, 57 steps for one epoch.
decision: PLAN.md: selection on dev, unseen-v1, combined /97 and family_new; second seed if combined >= 32 and no failure category loses >= 3 of round 54's items. The benchmark, neighbours, held-out families, reproduction and held-out combinations are reported.
